//: The server is confined to the directory Claude Code is running in. `--allow` is not optional and must never be widened to a home directory: `scema_tools::Workspace` answers *where*, and a cooperative model asked to audit a project will reason its way to ~/.ssh because that is genuinely relevant to an audit.
//decide: There is deliberately no --allow-decide here. Without it `omni_decide` is not advertised to the model at all, so it cannot seal records. Add it in your own project .mcp.json if you want that, having decided you want it.
